lines.name: Boulevard Line
lines.beyond: south to Southside: through-running; second terminus and depot off-sheet

lines.name: Skyport Line
lines.beyond: west to the West End along Circus Road

notes: What changed: I kept both alignments as drawn and added order [trunk, loop] to T1 and S1. Both lines chain trunk end to loop start, so N-O1 needs an order and neither line had one.

T1, checked by hand: trunk in the Boulevard (w28), end at sheet edge z -780. Loop fillets 25/28 meet radiusLoop 25 and fit their segments. The r28 arcs centre on (0,0), inside the island (r31). Diagonals run in the circus carriageway (31-43). The loop joins both tracks at z -56 (T-L1).

S1, checked by hand: straight trunk over Circus Road median, the circus, the Parade mall, Harbour Road median and the Skyport Pier (all public). Pylon gaps are 24 m or less (span 30). Turning loop is r40 = radiusLoop and stays over apron and water (spanTight 18). West end x -400 is the sheet edge.

Tide's two-way Sky Loop is not adopted. The straight trunk replaces it. It serves the same stations with one interchange, and a ring of pylons across the west city would land on built plots (S-P2). Retiring the old loop and harbour line is still open in notes.questions and needs Sky's OK via Aster.

Tide's T2 is held back: no legal south turn on Harbour Road. A r50 corner onto the Boulevard leaves the kerb (T-C1). A Dock Road balloon at r25 leaves the 12 m street and runs a tram through the Docks area (access-road rule). Reach: existing stops cover Docks, Harbour and Lantern within about 255 m of each area's middle.

Conflict between sources: notes.why (e20799…) still describes the old network: one track with no loop, a Sphere loop at r88, and a separate harbour balloon at R48. The current lines and notes.concept describe the trunk and balloon-loop design. Aster should stale-mark or rewrite notes.why.
The interchange holds: S1 Crown Circus (95,0) is about 119 m from T1 stop circus (0,-72), within interchange 150 (N-C1).
Evidence gap: I had no shell, so the plan checker was not run on this proposal. Every check in these notes was done by hand from the passed geometry.

handoffs.ask: S1 stations Harbour (340,0) and Skyport (530,0) are 190 m apart, under stationSpacing 200. Suggest moving Harbour to about x 325 on the causeway quay or pier. That gives 205 m to Skyport and 230 m to Crown Circus. Alignment is unchanged, so the move fits on the existing trunk.
No timetable changes: T1 and S1 alignments are unchanged and only path order was added. T2 is not proposed, so do not schedule a Harbour Line.
